id: \bViola is too hard. My team uses speed, but Sticky Web keeps getting in the way.
en: \bViola is too hard. My team uses speed, but Sticky Web keeps getting in the way.
it: \bVioletta è troppo forte. La mia squadra punta sulla velocità, ma Rete Vischiosa continua a mettermi i bastoni tra le ruote.

id: \bI wonder how you got this far. Most give up by Hoenn.
en: \bI wonder how you got this far. Most give up by Hoenn.
it: \bMi chiedo come tu sia arrivato fin qui. La maggior parte si arrende già a Hoenn.

id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.
